sloka: एवं परुषमुक्तस्तु हितबुद्धिरबुद्धिना ।अब्रवीद्रावणं सूतो हितं सानुनयं वचः ।। ६.१०६.१० ।।
transliteration: evaṁ paruṣamuktastu hitabuddhirabuddhinā ।abravīdrāvaṇaṁ sūto hitaṁ sānunayaṁ vacaḥ ।। 6.106.10 ।।

translations.english: When the insensitive Ravana spoke harshly in that manner, to the charioteer who was wishing his benefit, he spoke in friendly language to Ravana.
